BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled within an exceptionally private and mature setting on approximately 0.5 acres, Faoi lán seoil is a truly spectacular detached family residence that combines timeless elegance, generous proportions and modern energy efficiency in one of North County Dublin's most desirable locations. Hidden behind electronic gates and approached via a tree-lined driveway, this outstanding home enjoys complete privacy, surrounded by beautifully maintained gardens and mature landscaping, creating a peaceful sanctuary just minutes from every convenience.

Extending to an impressive c.360 sq.m. of beautifully appointed accommodation, the property has been thoughtfully designed with family living at its heart. From the moment you step inside, the quality and attention to detail are immediately apparent. The welcoming entrance hall features a magnificent solid staircase with bespoke balustrades, while 10-foot-high ceilings throughout the ground floor enhance the wonderful sense of space and light found throughout the home.

The accommodation flows effortlessly, with a bright and spacious living room positioned to the front of the property, offering an elegant yet comfortable setting for everyday family life and entertaining. At the heart of the home lies a stunning open-plan kitchen and dining area, complete with a bespoke solid in-frame country-style kitchen, large central island and premium solid countertops. This exceptional space seamlessly connects to a beautiful sunroom, creating a bright and inviting living environment where family and friends can gather throughout the year.

The bedroom accommodation is equally impressive, comprising four generously proportioned double bedrooms. The luxurious principal suite offers a private retreat, complete with a walk-in wardrobe and a beautifully appointed en-suite bathroom, while additional bedrooms provide excellent space and comfort for family members and guests alike.
Outside, the property continues to impress. The expansive gardens provide privacy, tranquillity and ample space for outdoor living and recreation. A recently constructed detached garden room offers superb flexibility and is currently utilised as a gym, complete with additional attic storage overhead. 

Modern convenience and security have been carefully integrated throughout the property. Features include a fully monitored intruder alarm system, CCTV security cameras linked directly to a mobile app, ample private parking and a bio-cycle waste treatment system. The home also benefits from an excellent A2 BER rating, ensuring impressive energy efficiency and year-round comfort.

Despite its wonderfully secluded setting, Faoi Lion enjoys exceptional connectivity. The M1 Motorway is only minutes away, providing swift access to Dublin Airport, Swords and Dublin City Centre. The charming coastal village of Rush, with its excellent schools, shops, cafés, restaurants and sporting amenities, is close by, while the natural beauty of Rogerstown Estuary offers wonderful opportunities for walking, recreation and wildlife appreciation.

Faoi lán seoil represents a rare opportunity to acquire an exceptional family home of remarkable quality, privacy and scale in a highly sought-after coastal location. Combining elegant interiors, extensive outdoor space and superb accessibility, this is a residence that truly offers the very best of country-style living within easy reach of Dublin City.
